prog='''def transform(grid):
    """Output a 3x3 block of the color of the largest single-component shape."""
    from collections import deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c = grid[i][j]
            if c == 0 or (i, j) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(i, j)]); seen.add((i, j)); n = 0
            while q:
                a, b = q.popleft(); n += 1
                for da, db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x, y = a+da, b+db
                    if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] == c and (x, y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x, y)); q.append((x, y))
            comps.append((c, n))
    sizes, counts = {}, {}
    for c, n in comps:
        sizes[c] = sizes.get(c, 0) + n
        counts[c] = counts.get(c, 0) + 1
    shapes = {c: sizes[c] for c in sizes if counts[c] == 1}
    color = max(shapes, key=shapes.get)
    return [[color]*3 for _ in range(3)]
'''

prog='''def transform(grid):
    """Output a 3x3 block of the color of the largest single-component shape."""
    from collections import deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c = grid[i][j]
            if c == 0 or (i, j) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(i, j)]); seen.add((i, j)); n = 0
            while q:
                a, b = q.popleft(); n += 1
                for da, db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x, y = a+da, b+db
                    if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] == c and (x, y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x, y)); q.append((x, y))
            comps.append((c, n))
    sizes, counts = {}, {}
    for c, n in comps:
        sizes[c] = sizes.get(c, 0) + n
        counts[c] = counts.get(c, 0) + 1
    shapes = {c: sizes[c] for c in sizes if counts[c] == 1}
    color = max(shapes, key=shapes.get)
    return [[color]*3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
